# Vendor cross-check (ruling (a), docs/wiki/truth-v4-plan.md)

Purpose: vendor labels are a cross-check, not truth. Pass rows that v4 calls w where AWS (Permissions management) or GitHub (admin, secrets, keys, roles write) hints x get a second look. Generated by `poc/v4-pass/vendor-check.mjs` (no args, deterministic).

## Inputs
- pass-key.csv, jev-facts-pass.jsonl, suspects/suspects-key.csv, suspects/sbatch-NNN-labels.csv, suspects/disagree/disagree-final.csv (v4 label = disagree-final final_class if present, else Jev's label).
- ../../rwxlite data/vendor/joined.jsonl (21536 lines; read-only).

## Join routes
- route 1: the line id appears as rwxlite:<id> in a pass row's origins: 4672 lines.
- route 2 (only when route 1 finds nothing): normKey from poc/v4-pass/merge.mjs (provider lowercased and stripped of a trailing .com/.io/...; method with QUERY folded to GET; path; operationId; summary whitespace-collapsed, lowercased): 2800 lines.
- unmatched lines: 14064.

## Candidates
- v4 w and joined to at least one hint x line: 45 pass rows (45 all-x, 0 mixed hints).
- by vendor_level (x lines): Permissions management: 25; read+write: 40; write: 236
- by hint_sub (x lines): admin: 266; null: 25; secret-key-role: 10

## Files
- candidates-key.csv: pass_id, v4_label, v4_source, source, vendor_level, hint_sub, rwxlite_ids (do not give to a labeller).
- candidates-blind.csv (+ .sha256): row_id vc001.., pass-key text only, no labels, hints or vendor fields; shuffled with mulberry32 + Fisher-Yates, seed 20261114.
- candidates-map.csv: row_id, pass_id.
